notes: Kitchen: a dish started in your first few seconds online is no longer handed over before it has cooked.
Auto-store skips a full saved page without opening it (lighter on the server).
Easy Building: anchors survive switching items, pickaxes no longer build an anchored shape, previews count their blocks again, and a dimension change clears the anchor.
Kitchen: a finished dish is never handed over twice, even if a save fails.
Chest Finder: new worlds start with the private index; switching to world-wide takes effect at once.
Realm Stats: a lighter stats ticker, and tied players share a place.
Diagnostics: shared saved-data prefixes stay unowned in /realm:diag instead of going to the first pack that touches them.

cooking_bp.notes: A batch still in the pot is no longer handed over early by the join handover (a cook in a player's first 5 seconds online, or the world's, was instant), and a finished dish is never handed over twice when the world fails to save at that moment.
